title: fix(metadata-protocol, objectql): a disabled package's export carries its items
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTXAQtrfk4vQJzg2rvidEwL)_
Fixes #29871

domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzej2VEHitTx5mznA8z

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:禁用的包导出时不再是空壳;单包导出和整库导出都带上它自己的对象、视图、仪表盘等条目。
- 为什么改:导出是本版新上的租户退出通道,禁用包导出为空、换环境安装后对象静默丢失且无报错,属于发版阻塞级的数据丢失。
- 风险与回滚:只改"按包读取层"(仅导出和匿名表单撤回判断读它);控制台、/meta、自动化等对外读取照旧隐藏禁用包。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`(keepDisabledPackages 两处)、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(listItems 第三参)、新测 `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-disabled-package.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-export-disabled-package.integration.test.ts`,预期 2 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A disabled package is still exported with its items. `PackageExportBundleSchema` declares every package exported "enabled or not" and installed enabled; a disable hides the items from the served reads and leaves them stored. The export (`assemblePackageManifest`) reads each package through the protocol's per-package layer (`getMetaItemsPerPackage` → `readFlattenedMetaItems(..., 'per-package')`), and that layer hid a disabled package's items in two places:

1. `SchemaRegistry.listItems` drops a disabled package's items for every registry type but `object`;
2. the protocol's final disabled-package filter (`isItemOfDisabledPackage`) drops them for every type, `object` included, after the overlay and metadata-service merges.

So `GET /packages/:id/export` and the bundle `GET /packages/export` (one producer) answered the package with `id`/`name`/`version`/`namespace` and nothing else.

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: `listItems(type, packageId?, options?)` takes `{ includeDisabledPackages: true }`; unset, it hides them as before. The `IObjectQLEngine` contract signature in `packages/spec` is unchanged (the parameter is optional; the protocol host reads the registry as `any`).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: on `layer === 'per-package'` only, the registry is listed with that option and the final disabled-package filter is skipped. The effective read (`getMetaItems`) and the execution face (`getMetaItemsForExecution`) still hide a disabled package's items, unchanged.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: the `getMetaItemsPerPackage` docblock states the third step the layer does not take, and what it means for its two readers.

The per-package layer's other reader, the anonymous form doors' withdrawal judgement (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`), now also sees a disabled package's views in its withdrawal layer. The doors offer only the effective list's forms (still without the disabled package's), and a body in the withdrawal layer can only close a form, so this can narrow anonymous intake and never widen it, the direction that layer is allowed (#28238 option 3).

Side effect, stated: a disabled package's view that withdraws a public form now also closes that form's name in other packages (the doors judge a withdrawal against every body in that layer, matched by slot or slug). That is the fail-closed direction.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `SchemaRegistry` is exported from `@objectstack/objectql`'s entry, so the optional third `listItems` argument widens that package's public surface. Level stays `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-disabled-package.integration.test.ts`, over the real door (`HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`), the real protocol and `ObjectQL` on a SQLite file:
  - the issue's repro: a runtime-authored package (installed through the protocol, an object and a dashboard drafted and published through `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`), disabled through `PATCH /packages/:id/disable`: its export is byte-identical to its export before the disable, and so is its bundle entry;
  - a registered package (`registerApp`: object, view container, dashboard), disabled in the registry: its export is byte-identical too;
  - CONTROL, each: `getMetaItems` lists the items while enabled and hides them once disabled.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts`: a second top-level describe on two showcase boots, the issue's steps end to end: `POST /packages`, `PUT /meta/object/NAME?mode=draft&package=ID`, `publish-drafts`, `PATCH …/disable`; the per-package export and the bundle entry still carry the object; a fresh runtime installs the entry through `POST /marketplace/install-local` (`os package install`) and `GET /meta/object/NAME` answers 200.

## Acceptance notes

- Wanted 1 (export carries a disabled package's own items, served reads keep hiding them): both integration cases and their controls.
- Wanted 2 (real boot: disable a published package, its export still carries its object; a fresh install of the bundle serves it): the dogfood describe.
- Serial with #29760 / #29872 on `assemblePackageManifest`: this PR does not edit that function.

## Verification

Readings on objectstack-ai/objectstack, shared cloud box. The final head `7d618b49` changes only the changeset's `Clause-②` line and prose. Suites, ablation and derived gates at `68cabb9a`; `473f2d18` changes only the dogfood file (each runtime gets its own `OS_HOME`), and the dogfood readings below are at that head.

<details><summary>Package suites (each under the verify lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 546 files, 10809 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 311 passed, 4 skipped files; 22311 passed, 26 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 538 files; 8588 passed, 19 skipped (the new file included).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` (the per-package layer's other reader, the form doors): 383 files; 7155 passed, 332 skipped.
- `test:repo` is not run locally; it is CI's (`Test Core`).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the fix</summary>

Both src files restored to `00f72f94` (`git restore --source`), `objectql` and `metadata-protocol` rebuilt, the `includeDisabledPackages` marker absent from both dists (0 / 0 files): the new integration file reds 2 of 2. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --` (diff vs HEAD empty), rebuilt, marker present (2 / 1 files): 2 of 2 green.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 67 families from the 6 changed paths; all 67 run. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 run, 1 NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite: a whole-repo build), CI's. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone until its pinned fixture commit was fetched, then 48 cases passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Typecheck, lint, dogfood</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts` (after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build): 8 passed (both describes).
- Ablation on the dogfood file, same recipe as above: 2 failed (the disabled export carries its object; the target serves it), 6 passed; restored: 8 passed.
- The first dogfood run went red at "the target serves it" with `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`: both boots shared one `OS_HOME`, where a disable is persisted (`package-state/`) and replayed at boot, so the target replayed the source's disable. That is the test harness, not the export (the bundle carries no enabled state); each runtime now gets its own home, and no state file is left under the default home.
- Full dogfood not run: the title carries no `!` and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm.
</details>
